open: Make a how-to video in Claude Motion, voice and all.
ask-a: Open the OmniOrders test account in Chrome, then open Claude.
ask-b: Ask for a Motion film of the steps, on the real screens.
ask-c: One step per scene, a cursor, a short caption. Then send.
build-a: Claude captures each screen and builds the film.
build-b: It opens in Claude Motion. Play it, and ask for any changes.
export: When it looks right, click the download arrow to export the MP4.
voice-a: Now the voice. In ElevenLabs, pick the Matilda voice.
voice-b: Paste one caption, click Generate speech, and download the clip.
voice-c: Make one clip for each caption.
mix-a: Back in Claude, click plus and add the MP4 and the clips.
mix-b: Ask Claude to put each clip under its caption. You get back the finished MP4.
end: That's it. Real screens, a clear voice, ready for the docs.
